'''Dorf''' was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], and a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. A senior [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], the Padawan was at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Following the [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|battle of Kothlis]], Dorf joined fellow Padawan, [[Biliril]] and Master [[Taria Damsin]] late one evening for a meal in one of the [[Jedi Temple refectory/Legends|Temple dining halls]]. During the meal, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] entered the abandoned room and sat alone, as he did not want to discuss the events on [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]].<ref name="CWGS" />
